notes.title: (On august) The Asfrixa - Free Complete Chapter One on a Demo
notes.content:
Chapter One of The Asfrixa that will introduce the player to the universe of The. And Elf will be available for free in stores in August with a Demo!

Even though it is classified as a Demo, Chapter One has been worked on as a part of a large game and in an introductory way to all the mechanics in the style of play we want.

We'll be announcing what's to come soon, but we can compare the new version to the Demo BETA released in January:

- Improved Catch Box System.

- Changed Character Movements

- Buttons now deactivate when there is no weight pressing them.

- The door can be closed

- Dramatic performance gains

- Animations

- Physics are disabled when not used.

- Switching from Unreal Engine 5 Early Access to Unreal Engine 5.0.3

- Interface changes and adds like: Language Change, Audio Options, Brightness, Controls, Achievements and game notifications

- Ray Tracing support for nvidia cards.

We also revamped the game's Graphics Assets to give it a more original feel.

Add to Wishlist to be the first to try it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1902170/The_Asfrixa
